Founder describes Loops' approach: simplified pricing (no tables, one metric), performant API with versioning for transactional email, text-based customizable editor, SaaS lifecycle templates, unlimited team seats, and Slack Connect support channels (almost 1,000).
User comment: "I've used it (no affiliation to the company). I like it because it's easy... I have the sense they'd all be more complex and more annoying to use (even if they might be cheaper)."
Complaint: clicking 'Pricing' link on the site gave no response.
Complaint: "My Firefox browser consumes 600% CPU browsing the homepage. Maybe an endless loop somewhere? I use adblock."
Concern raised: 'your service seems priced in a way that encourages spam (send unlimited emails to an address)' regarding deliverability/dedicated IPs and use of AWS SES as MTA.
Existing user feedback: "I'm a happy user! for sure there are some small basic things I'd love to get (better filtering, user editing, etc...) but overall they get the job done. Good luck!"
Founder explains editor was rewritten using Lexical (switched from Slate.js) to power their text-based, customizable email editor, built on extended MJML.

Comparison discussion: users questioned how Loops differs from Customer.io, Userlist, SendGrid, and noted the email tooling space (Klaviyo, Substack, ConvertKit) is crowded, with most providers ultimately wrapping SES/SendGrid infrastructure.
